method: Read-only evaluated saved meshes. No authoring helpers imported. Contact points and rack extents measured from actual geometry, not declared placement metadata.

checks.test: Eleven separately constructed cargo families have materially different dimensions
Luggage rests across a broad base rather than on a handle or single corner
All 118 cargo pieces touch their actual shelf surface
All cargo fits inside rack trays with upper-deck and liner clearance
Cargo retains authored size and leaves the stair landing and central aisle clear
Adjacent pieces in split bays do not intersect
Checked cases laid on their backs bear on rear wear pads with trolley grips above the tray
All ten modeled aircraft tires share the apron contact plane
Exterior dimensions are derived from actual delivered mesh bounds
Rebuilt nose preserves horizon and upward glazing views from both pilot seats
Accepted interaction definitions, walking barriers and floor heights are unchanged
Both editable sources are identical and the audit did not modify them

limits: Static support contact does not simulate shifting baggage under turbulence. Native walking and interaction evidence is separate.
